label: Employer
summary: The character's employer.
details: Works on a character. Vanilla uses it about 100 times.

label: Enemy side
summary: The opposing side of a combat.
details: Works on one side of a combat and leads to the other side. Vanilla uses it often (about 126 times).

label: Epidemic trait
summary: The trait that an epidemic of this type spreads.
details: Works on an epidemic type, not on a running epidemic. To get there from an epidemic, go through its type first.

label: Epidemic type
summary: The type of the epidemic.
details: Works on an epidemic and leads to its type, for example to read the trait it spreads.

label: Epidemic type by key
summary: The epidemic type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `epidemic_type:<key>`. Works anywhere, no starting object needed.

label: Event by id
summary: A global link that the game's documentation describes as the event with the given event id.
details: The game's documentation says it leads to an event but lists its result type as a flag, which does not fit. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Faction leader
summary: The leader of the faction.
details: Works on a faction and leads to a character.

label: Faction target
summary: The faction's target character.
details: Works on a faction and leads to a character. Vanilla uses it a lot (about 386 times).

label: Faction war
summary: The war that belongs to the faction.
details: Works on a faction and leads to a war. The game's documentation does not say how the war comes about or what it gives while the faction has none.

label: Faith
summary: The faith of a character, title, province, great holy war or rite.
details: Works on any of those five and leads to a faith. It is one of the most used links in vanilla (over 11,000 uses, together with the key form).

label: Faith by key
summary: The faith with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `faith:<key>`. Works anywhere, no starting object needed.

label: Theocratic government type
summary: The faith's theocratic government type.
details: Works on a faith and leads to a government type. The key is spelled "goverment" in the game; write it that way. Vanilla uses it only a few times.

label: Fallback successor
summary: The character's fallback succession character.
details: Works on a character and leads to a character. The game's documentation does not explain when a fallback successor applies, and vanilla never uses it.

label: Fallback succession title
summary: The character's fallback succession title.
details: Works on a character and leads to a title. The game's documentation does not explain when it applies, and vanilla never uses it.

label: Father
summary: The character's father.
details: Works on a character and leads to a character.

label: Final destination
summary: The last province of a travel plan.
details: Works on a travel plan and leads to a province.

label: Flag
summary: A flag value written directly in script, such as `flag:the_boss`.
details: Works anywhere. Whatever you write after the colon is the flag. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Forced next councillor
summary: The character who will be the next forced councillor for the active council task.
details: Works on a council task (the documented example is `scope:council_task_steward`) and leads to a character. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Founder
summary: The founder of the faith.
details: Works on a faith and leads to a character.

label: Founder culture
summary: The culture of the accolade's founder.
details: Works on an accolade and leads to a culture. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Founder dynasty
summary: The dynasty of the accolade's founder.
details: Works on an accolade and leads to a dynasty. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Founder faith
summary: The faith of the accolade's founder.
details: Works on an accolade and leads to a faith. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Founder house
summary: The dynasty house of the accolade's founder.
details: Works on an accolade and leads to a dynasty house. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Geographical region by key
summary: The geographical region with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `geographical_region:<key>`. Works anywhere, no starting object needed. Vanilla uses it once.

label: Great holy war beneficiary
summary: The great holy war beneficiary that goes with the character.
details: Works on a character and leads to a character. The game's documentation does not say which great holy war it looks at or who counts as the beneficiary.

label: Designated winner
summary: The character who is designated to win the great holy war.
details: Works on a great holy war and leads to a character.

label: Target character
summary: The character the great holy war is aimed at.
details: Works on a great holy war and leads to a character.

label: Target title
summary: The title the great holy war is aimed at.
details: Works on a great holy war and leads to a title.

label: Title recipient
summary: The character who receives the title of the great holy war.
details: Works on a great holy war and leads to a character.

label: Great holy war's war
summary: The war that belongs to the great holy war.
details: The game's documentation says it works on a war, but its input list names only great holy wars, and the app labels it as going from a great holy war to its war. Going by the input list, write it on a great holy war.

label: War declarer
summary: The character who declared the great holy war.
details: Works on a great holy war and leads to a character.

label: Global variable
summary: The value of a global variable that was set earlier, found by the name you write after the colon.
details: Written `global_var:<name>`, for example `global_var:important_thing`. Works anywhere. The game's documentation lists no result type. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Government type
summary: The character's government type.
details: Works on a character and leads to a government type.

label: Government type by key
summary: The government type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `government_type:<key>`. Works anywhere, no starting object needed.

label: Great holy war
summary: The great holy war of the faith.
details: Works on a faith and leads to its great holy war. Vanilla uses it a lot (about 595 times).

label: Great project
summary: The great project that a contribution belongs to.
details: Works on a project contribution and leads to a great project.

label: Project founder
summary: The character who founded the great project.
details: The founder may be dead. The game says the result is never empty.

label: Project founder's heir
summary: The living primary heir of the project's founder, or the founder if they are still alive.
details: The result can be empty: the heir may have no land, be dead, or not exist. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Project location
summary: The province where the great project is located, if it has one.
details: Works on a great project and leads to a province. It can be empty.

label: Project owner
summary: The character who currently owns the great project.
details: The game works it out as the top liege of whoever holds the project's location. The game says the result is never empty.

label: Project type
summary: The type of the great project.
details: Works on a great project and leads to its type.

label: Great project type by key
summary: The great project type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `great_project_type:<key>`. Works anywhere, no starting object needed.

label: Head of rite
summary: The character who is the head of the rite, if there is one.
details: Works on a rite and leads to a character. The result can be empty.

label: Hegemony title
summary: The de jure hegemony title of a title or province.
details: Works on a title or a province and leads to a title. Vanilla uses it only a few times (about 11).

label: Holder
summary: The character who holds the title.
details: Works on a title and leads to a character. It is one of the most used links in vanilla (about 6,900 uses).

label: Holding type
summary: The type of holding in the province.
details: Works on a province and leads to a holding type.

label: Holding type by key
summary: The holding type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `holding_type:<key>`. Works anywhere, no starting object needed.

label: Holy order
summary: The character's holy order, if there is one.
details: Works on a character and leads to a holy order. The result can be empty.

label: Patron
summary: The patron of the holy order.
details: Works on a holy order and leads to a character.

label: Holy site by key
summary: The holy site of the static holy site type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `holy_site:<key>`. Works anywhere, no starting object needed.
